title: Red glass craft
description: This mod adds the ability to smelt red sand in a furnace to create red glass.
body: Have you ever wondered why I can smelt regular sand to create glass, but I can't smelt red sand to create red glass? I've fixed that! This mod saves you resources and adds a small, logical detail. Simply place the red sand in the furnace and fill it with any fuel. Your red glass is ready!
